Class SuppressionHandler

java.lang.Object
org.xml.sax.helpers.DefaultHandler
org.owasp.dependencycheck.xml.suppression.SuppressionHandler
All Implemented Interfaces:
ContentHandler, DTDHandler, EntityResolver, ErrorHandler
@NotThreadSafe public class SuppressionHandler extends DefaultHandler
A handler to load suppression rules. In the input xml a suppression rule can be part of a suppressionGroup. In that case the attributes set on group element will act as default values for child suppressions.
Author:
Jeremy Long
